Item 1. Business

Meridian Tools sells industrial equipment through independent distributors. Equipment is used in factories and warehouses.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Supply chain disruptions can delay manufacturing. A single supplier provides the specialty steel used in our tools.

Foreign currency fluctuations affect overseas sales when translated into dollars. Currency exposure remains unhedged.

Item 1C. Cybersecurity

The security committee reviews cybersecurity incidents every quarter. Network monitoring detects unauthorized access attempts.

Item 7. Management Discussion and Analysis

Freight costs increased because shipping capacity was constrained. Management negotiated new transportation contracts.

Item 8. Financial Statements

Revenue is recognized when control of delivered equipment transfers to the customer.
